entities.summary: Paul Ronty was a Canadian professional ice hockey centre. Ronty started his National Hockey League career with the Boston Bruins in 1947. He also played for the New York Rangers and Montreal Canadiens. He retired after the 1955 season. Three times during his career, he finished sixth in league scoring.
